using System;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Roost.Client;

class Program
{
    static int Main()
    {
        bool control = Run(false);
        bool disposal = Run(true);
        return control && disposal ? 0 : 1;
    }

    static bool Run(bool disposeInFirst)
    {
        using var client = new GameClient(new ConnectionOptions { Host = "127.0.0.1", Port = 12345 });
        // 保持取票未完成，只驱动正式 Connecting/Pump 路径，不打开网络连接。
        var ticket = new TaskCompletionSource<string>(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
        var opening = client.Connection.ConnectAsync(_ => ticket.Task);
        int secondCalls = 0;
        bool afterDispose = false;
        client.StateChanged += _ => { if (disposeInFirst) client.Dispose(); };
        client.StateChanged += _ =>
        {
            secondCalls++;
            afterDispose = client.Connection.State == ConnectionState.Disposed;
        };
        client.Pump();
        client.Dispose();
        try { opening.GetAwaiter().GetResult(); }
        catch (OperationCanceledException) { }
        int expected = disposeInFirst ? 0 : 1;
        Console.WriteLine($"disposeInFirst={disposeInFirst}: secondCalls={secondCalls}, afterDispose={afterDispose}, expected={expected}");
        return secondCalls == expected && !afterDispose;
    }
}
